large_file_detection.rationale: No file-size/line-count hook, CI threshold, LFS configuration, or enabled equivalent linter was found.

tech_debt_tracking.rationale: TODO/FIXME comments exist, but no scanner, issue-link enforcement, technical-debt platform, or documented debt tracking process was found.

build_cmd_doc.rationale: README.md documents Go 1.26+, cloning, and building in cmd/caddy; AGENTS.md also documents go build ./....

deps_pinned.rationale: The single go.mod specifies fixed dependency versions, with checksums committed in go.sum.

vcs_cli_tools.rationale: Both gh auth status and glab auth status returned command not found; no authenticated VCS CLI is available.

automated_pr_review.rationale: Skipped because neither GitHub nor GitLab CLI is installed/authenticated; release-status comments do not establish automated code review.

agentic_development.rationale: No agent-invoking workflows, scripts, skills, or agent co-authorship were found. AGENTS.md and disclosure policies alone do not prove active agent development; history contains only one shallow-clone commit.

fast_ci_feedback.rationale: Skipped: no authenticated VCS CLI is available to measure actual PR check start-to-completion durations.

build_performance_tracking.rationale: Skipped: no authenticated VCS CLI or explicit build-performance metrics/analysis were found. Standard setup-go/action defaults alone do not establish deliberate performance tracking.

deployment_frequency.rationale: Skipped: no authenticated VCS CLI is available to inspect release and deployment-run frequency.

single_command_setup.rationale: README.md provides a short clone/build sequence and a go run development launch example; AGENTS.md documents the self-starting integration harness.

feature_flag_infrastructure.rationale: No feature-flag platform or custom flag lifecycle/targeting system was found; optional server configuration is not feature-flag infrastructure.

release_notes_automation.rationale: .goreleaser.yml generates a filtered changelog, and release-proposal.yml generates changes since the previous release.

progressive_rollout.rationale: Skipped: this is server source and release tooling, not a deployment-infrastructure repository managing rollout environments.

rollback_automation.rationale: Skipped: this source/release repository does not manage deployed infrastructure environments; reload support is not release rollback automation.

monorepo_tooling.rationale: Skipped: one application and one Go build module; internal packages and Caddy runtime modules are not separate applications.

version_drift_detection.rationale: Skipped: only one build module (root go.mod) exists, so there are no sibling build-module versions to compare.

release_automation.rationale: Release proposal/approval workflows and tag-triggered GoReleaser automate builds, signing, packaging, and publishing; release_published.yml dispatches downstream packaging.

dead_feature_flag_detection.rationale: Skipped because feature_flag_infrastructure does not pass; no managed feature-flag system exists.

agents_md.rationale: Root AGENTS.md exceeds 100 characters and documents architecture, naming, build/test/lint commands, contribution rules, and module conventions.

readme.rationale: Root README.md describes purpose, requirements, source builds, installation, usage, and quick-start documentation.

automated_doc_generation.rationale: .goreleaser.yml runs Caddy's manpage generator and packages generated manual pages during release builds.

skills.rationale: No repository-local {skill-name}/SKILL.md files or valid skills directories were found; session-provided skills are not repository evidence.

documentation_freshness.rationale: The requested git-log check returns README.md and AGENTS.md at 2026-11-01, within 180 days. The clone is shallow, limiting historical attribution.

service_flow_documented.rationale: README.md documents external certificate providers (ZeroSSL/Let's Encrypt), while AGENTS.md describes HTTP/TLS/PKI modules, configuration flow, and the CertMagic dependency.

agents_md_validation.rationale: No automation extracts, validates, regenerates, or link-checks AGENTS.md. CI independently running similar commands does not validate the document.

devcontainer.rationale: No .devcontainer/devcontainer.json or equivalent checked-in devcontainer configuration was found.

env_template.rationale: No .env.example exists, and README.md/AGENTS.md do not enumerate environment variables or explicitly document the required/optional environment contract.

local_services_setup.rationale: Skipped: the local HTTP QA target requires no external database/service; optional ACME-server persistence uses embedded bbolt.

devcontainer_runnable.rationale: Skipped: the devcontainer CLI is unavailable; no devcontainer was built or run.

runbooks_documented.rationale: No operational incident-response runbook/playbook or explicit runbook pointer was found. General support and vulnerability-reporting links are not operational runbooks.

branch_protection.rationale: Skipped: gh/glab are unavailable, so authenticated admin access and modern rulesets/legacy protection cannot be verified.

secret_scanning.rationale: .pre-commit-config.yaml configures the gitleaks hook. This supplies file-based secret-scanning evidence without native repository API access.

codeowners.rationale: No CODEOWNERS file was found at the root, .github, or elsewhere in the repository.

automated_security_review.rationale: lint.yml runs govulncheck and dependency-review-action with comment-summary-in-pr: on-failure; scorecard.yml retains and uploads readable SARIF assessments.

dependency_update_automation.rationale: .github/dependabot.yml configures monthly grouped Go-module and GitHub Actions dependency-update PRs; live PR activity could not be verified without gh.

gitignore_comprehensive.rationale: .gitignore covers Caddy binaries, release artifacts, vendor, IDE files, and .DS_Store, but only cmd/caddy/.env is ignored; root/nested .env secrets are not generally excluded.

privacy_compliance.rationale: modules/logging/filters.go implements IP masking, hashing, and field deletion; credential headers are omitted by default, providing privacy-by-design data minimization.

secrets_management.rationale: CI/release workflows use GitHub Actions secrets references for signing, publishing, and dispatch credentials rather than checked-in credential values.

min_release_age.rationale: Dependabot's monthly schedule does not enforce release age. No explicit minimum-age/cooldown delay or documented N-day waiting policy was found.

issue_templates.rationale: .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ISSUE.yml provides required issue details and assistance-disclosure fields for actionable bugs/features.

issue_labeling_system.rationale: Only release-workflow status labels are evidenced locally; no consistent priority, type, and area label taxonomy is documented/configured, and gh is unavailable.

backlog_health.rationale: Skipped: no authenticated VCS CLI is available to inspect issue titles, labels, ages, and recent activity.

pr_templates.rationale: .github/pull_request_template.md exists but contains only assistance disclosure; it lacks description, testing-done, and context sections.

lint_config.rationale: .golangci.yml configures golangci-lint v2 with govet, staticcheck, gosec, dupl, unused, and other checks; lint.yml invokes it in CI.

type_check.rationale: Go is statically typed; documented and CI go build commands invoke compiler type checking. Local compilation was not attempted because Go is unavailable.

formatter.rationale: .golangci.yml enables gofmt, gofumpt, goimports, and gci; pre-commit configuration includes a formatter hook.

pre_commit_hooks.rationale: .pre-commit-config.yaml defines gitleaks, golangci-lint, formatting, shellcheck, whitespace, and EOF checks. Hook execution was not validated locally.

strict_typing.rationale: Skipped: Go has no distinct stricter type-checking mode beyond its normal compiler; compiler evidence is already scored under type_check.

naming_consistency.rationale: AGENTS.md explicitly requires Go initialisms, short receiver names, lowercase error strings, and named doc comments.

cyclomatic_complexity.rationale: The enabled golangci-lint analyzers do not include a cyclomatic/cognitive complexity threshold; no separate complexity-monitoring tool was found.

dead_code_detection.rationale: .golangci.yml enables staticcheck and unused, which detect unused/dead code across application packages.

duplicate_code_detection.rationale: .golangci.yml enables dupl; exclusions are scoped to selected files rather than disabling duplicate-code detection globally.

code_modularization.rationale: Root internal/ and modules/internal/ packages provide compiler-enforced Go import boundaries.

n_plus_one_detection.rationale: The optional ACME server uses embedded bbolt persistence, but no database-query/lookup amplification detector or analysis tooling was found.

heavy_dependency_detection.rationale: Skipped: Caddy is a Go server/CLI, not a bundled frontend; browser bundle-size analysis does not apply.

unused_dependencies_detection.rationale: AGENTS.md recommends go mod tidy, and release preparation tidies a generated build module, but CI does not check unused dependencies in the root application module.

unit_tests_exist.rationale: Many *_test.go files exist at the root and in packages, including replacer_test.go, context_test.go, and modules/logging/filters_test.go.

integration_tests_exist.rationale: caddytest/integration contains HTTP, TLS, reverse-proxy, authentication, and other end-to-end tests backed by caddytest.Tester.

unit_tests_runnable.rationale: Skipped: go version returned command not found (exit 127 in the toolchain probe). No test command or full suite was run; a missing language runtime is not a repository failure.

test_performance_tracking.rationale: CI runs go test and generates coverage, but no deliberate suite-duration reporting/retention, test analytics, or performance trend tracking is configured.

flaky_test_detection.rationale: ci.yml's s390x-test job explicitly retries failed tests up to three times, satisfying the configured test-retry mechanism criterion; live run history is unavailable.

test_coverage_thresholds.rationale: CI generates cover-profile.out, but no minimum coverage threshold, blocking coverage status, or coverage quality gate is configured.

test_naming_conventions.rationale: Tests follow Go's compiler/runner-enforced *_test.go and TestX naming conventions; AGENTS.md also documents testing patterns.

test_isolation.rationale: t.Parallel() is used in matcher, variable, and FastCGI tests; temporary directories and test cleanup also provide isolation.

interactive_qa_exists.rationale: README.md supplies the Go prerequisite; AGENTS.md documents the integration command and a server-plus-HTTP-200 assertion. The checked-in harness starts Caddy on localhost and needs no login or external service.

interactive_qa_runnable.rationale: Documentation fallback: Go is unavailable, so no live run occurred. AGENTS.md and TestRespond define a complete local harness path; certificates are checked in, the server self-starts, and HTTP /version is asserted 200 without auth.

api_schema_docs.rationale: Caddy exposes an HTTP admin API, but recursive discovery found no OpenAPI/Swagger specification or GraphQL schema. A configuration-documentation test fixture is not an API schema.

database_schema.rationale: The ACME-server module opens a bbolt database through Smallstep; no repository-local data-model/schema definitions or migrations describe its persisted records.

structured_logging.rationale: go.mod includes go.uber.org/zap; logging.go and modules/logging implement structured, module-scoped logging.

distributed_tracing.rationale: modules/caddyhttp/tracing uses OpenTelemetry/otelhttp, extracts and injects trace context, and adds trace/span IDs to request logging.

metrics_collection.rationale: Prometheus metrics are implemented for admin requests, reload success, HTTP handlers, and other components, with metrics endpoints/modules.

code_quality_metrics.rationale: ci.yml runs go test -coverprofile=cover-profile.out, configuring code-coverage measurement. Upload/analysis is commented out and no threshold is enforced.

error_tracking_contextualized.rationale: No Sentry, Bugsnag, Rollbar, or equivalent contextual error-tracking integration was found; structured logs alone do not meet this criterion.

alerting_configured.rationale: No PagerDuty/OpsGenie integration, alert rules, or configured custom failure-notification pipeline was found.

deployment_observability.rationale: No deployment-impact dashboard pointers or deploy notification/monitoring annotations were found; instrumentation alone is insufficient.

health_checks.rationale: modules/caddyhttp/reverseproxy/healthchecks.go implements active HTTP health probes and passive upstream health tracking, satisfying load-balancer health checks.

circuit_breakers.rationale: Reverse-proxy passive health checks track failures, suppress unhealthy upstreams, and recover after fail_duration; circuit-breaker hooks and retry behavior provide resilience.

profiling_instrumentation.rationale: admin.go registers /debug/pprof/ CPU/heap profiling endpoints, trace, and expvar instrumentation.

dast_scanning.rationale: Custom live-endpoint security tests in reverseproxy/headers_test.go reject malicious hop-by-hop/Connection-nominated headers. Normal short/race CI runs these tests against httptest servers; no external DAST scanner is configured.

pii_handling.rationale: Logging filters explicitly mask client IP addresses and hash/delete sensitive fields; HTTP logging omits credential headers by default.

log_scrubbing.rationale: modules/logging/filters.go provides delete/hash/replace/IP-mask/query/cookie filters, and HTTP logging suppresses credentials by default.

product_analytics_instrumentation.rationale: No Mixpanel, Amplitude, PostHog, Heap, GA4, or equivalent product-usage analytics instrumentation was found.

error_to_insight_pipeline.rationale: No error-tracker-to-issue integration, error-driven issue automation, or incident-to-backlog pipeline was found.
